I think it’s long past time for Congress to pass a few more of these rescission packages. It’s time to end the wasteful spending.

I've been the lone vote against budgets that exploded our debt past $39 Trilion. My Six Penny Plan is the answer both parties refuse to pass: cut six cents from every projected dollar for 5 years and balance the budget. The math works. The will to get it done is what's missing.
